findings.title: The shipped example silently emitted a blank rsID percentage when bc was unavailable, and did not reject bad optional gnomAD inputs.
findings.fix: Use awk for the percentage; require indexed target/source VCFs; reject a nonexistent GNOMAD_VCF and zero shared contig names before annotate.
